chooseTask.en: What do you want to do?

summary.en: Bring eggs back from KPOP mascots, hatch photocards and train your speed for the next run.

label.en: Getting Started: Your First Egg and Photocard

description.en: Follow the tutorial arrows from your base to an egg and back to a hatch slot.

label.en: Speed and Treadmill Upgrades

description.en: Train during hatch timers and compare the displayed gain after upgrading.

label.en: Hatching Eggs: Placement, Timers and Returns

description.en: Confirm that incubation has started and plan your next action around the visible timer.

description.en: Read each displayed card’s rate and use verified income information before upgrading.
